name: rill
description: Syntax, outline, formatting and diagnostics for the rill dataflow language.

rill.binaryPath.markdownDescription: The rill binary that backs formatting and diagnostics. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; a relative path is resolved against the workspace folder. It needs the `fmt` and `check` subcommands, which rill has shipped since 2026-09-09: `zig build` in the rill checkout writes `zig-out/bin/rill`, and a symlink from `~/.local/bin` puts it on `PATH`. If the binary is missing or does not understand them, both features go quietly unavailable and everything else keeps working.

rill.format.enable.description: Offer Format Document / Format On Save for .rill files. Formatting is only ever applied when the binary hands back a formatted program and exits 0.

rill.format.args.markdownDescription:
Arguments for the format call. The source is written to stdin and the formatted program is read from stdout, so the last argument is normally `-`.

**Add your host's words here too.** `fmt` has to PARSE the file before it can print it, so a spray kernel that uses `spawn` or `near` does not format at all with the bare default — 21 of the 47 `.rill` programs in this checkout are that case. In a spindrift or matryoshka workspace set this to `["fmt", "--host-row", "-"]`, the same way `rill.diagnostics.args` is set.

rill.diagnostics.args.markdownDescription: Arguments for the diagnostics call. **Add your host's words here.** rill core does not know `spawn`, `near` or `drift` — they belong to spindrift and to matryoshka — so a plain `check` reports a false `unknown_operator` on 21 of the 47 corpus files. In a spindrift or matryoshka workspace set this to `["check", "--json", "--host-row", "-"]`.

enumDescriptions: Re-check on save and on open only.

rill.diagnostics.unknownNames.markdownDescription: How to report a diagnostic the checker codes `unknown_operator`. The operator registry is open — the host injects its own words at startup — so a name this binary has never heard of is not necessarily a mistake. Downgraded by default; set to `error` once `rill.diagnostics.args` names your host's vocabulary.

scripts.test: node --test test/grammar.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs test/config.test.mjs test/extension.test.mjs test/e2e.test.mjs
